My part of round 149 (V-1a) is done and passes every check I'm allowed to run. C has not checked it in the browser yet, so V-1a is not marked complete. Nothing was committed or pushed.

**Test path in the task is wrong (please pass this to C):** §3.3 names `app/lib/arrangement/__tests__/studio-lab-demo.test.tsx`, which doesn't exist. The real file is `app/data/__tests__/studio-lab-demo.test.ts`, and I used that. C's T149-TARGETED needs these 5 files and counts:
- `app/lib/arrangement/__tests__/default-track-names-ssr.test.tsx`: 2
- `app/data/__tests__/studio-lab-demo.test.ts`: 13

- `app/lib/arrangement/__tests__/strings.test.ts`: 51
- `app/lib/arrangement/__tests__/studio-theme-obsidian.test.tsx`: 4 (new)

**What changed (only the 5 files B allowed):**
- **`app/styles/app.css`:** the §1.1 block is appended at the end, byte-for-byte as specified (22 lines added, 0 removed).
- **`StudioWorkspace.tsx`:** one added line, `data-studio-theme="obsidian"`, on the Studio root.
- **Doc 121:** the three status lines from §2 (lines 4, 125, 129).
- **New test file `studio-theme-obsidian.test.tsx`:** four tests, TH1–TH4, all with hand-written values.
- **New doc 122:** in Georgian, with all the template sections and the status "In Progress (C round 149 — ჯერ არ გაშვებულა)".

**Checks I ran:**
- **Before editing:** HEAD was b292ff4 with a clean working tree, the 965 frozen-file hashes matched, and so did the 3 granted start hashes. The 4 existing test files passed 73/73.
- **After editing:** `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` exit 0. The lint run reports 218 warnings, none in the changed files. Biome reports nothing on the two changed code files. The 5 test files pass 77/77, with the old files' counts unchanged.
- **Mutations m114–m118:** each one made exactly the expected tests fail. Each was then undone and confirmed by hash. I ran m118 again on the final version of the test file and got the same result.
- **End state:** the 965 frozen files still match, `git status` shows 3 modified and 2 new files, and the protected files have no changes.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer agent found no Critical, High or Medium issues, only Lows, and scored it 9/10. I fixed one style nit in the new test file (a loop without braces). These Lows are for B:
- **Browsers without `:has()`:** the whole scoped block is ignored there, so Studio falls back to the Store colours. The block's text is fixed by §1.1, so I only recorded this.
- **Leaving `/studio-lab` in-app:** during the page transition, the next Store page may briefly show the warm colours. No C row checks this.
- **Production build:** C's exact-text token comparison could fail there if the CSS is minified.

The reviewer's Architecture note goes to B word for word in the report. In short: keep the block in `app.css` for now, and move it to its own `studio-theme.css` only if V-1b or V-2 add more Studio-only rules.

**Not run by me:**
- **Browser rows:** I didn't open a browser, so the colours, contrast, layout and the portal surfaces are unchecked until C's browser rows run.
- **Gate rows:** the full test suite, `npm run verify`, build and e2e. Your instructions said to run the build, but B's task forbids it because it writes into `store/`, so I followed B.

**Known gap:** as B planned, the text-field borders (DUX-B-3) get fainter for now, about 1.15:1 instead of 1.51:1. V-1b fixes them.
